_readme: SITE-WIDE SETTINGS. Edit this file to change your name, tagline, navigation, links and footer. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored by the build.
name: Harshith Roshan

_baseUrl: The live address of the deployed site, with a trailing slash. It is only used for canonical URLs, Open Graph tags and the sitemap — page links are relative, so the site works at any path. _links: Leave a URL empty ("") and the site shows a clearly marked placeholder instead of a broken or invented link. Fill these in when you have them.
